import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os

# Set paths
input_dir = "./input"
submission_dir = "./submission"
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/sample_submission.csv")

# Prepare features - exclude id and target columns
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ["id", "target"]]
X_train_full = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train_full = train_df["target"].values.astype(float)
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

# Sort feature columns consistently
X_train_full = X_train_full.reindex(feature_cols, axis=1)
X_test = X_test.reindex(feature_cols, axis=1)

# Handle categorical feature f_27 with label encoding
if "f_27" in X_train_full.columns:
    from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

    le = LabelEncoder()
    X_train_full["f_27"] = le.fit_transform(X_train_full["f_27"].astype(str))
    X_test["f_27"] = le.transform(X_test["f_27"].astype(str))

# Create a genuine hold-out split from training data ONLY (no test data leakage)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_full
)

# Train model with optimized parameters for better ROC AUC
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier

model = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=63,
    max_depth=-1,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    min_child_samples=20,
    scale_pos_weight=1.0,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
)

model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Evaluate on validation set - TRUE HOLD-OUT (model never saw these during training)
val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
auc_roc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)

# Generate final submission predictions on TEST DATA (unlabeled)
test_preds = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create submission file with proper format matching sample_submission
submission = sample_submission.copy()
submission["target"] = test_preds
submission.to_csv(f"{submission_dir}/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {auc_roc:.6f}")
